texture_binding.mode: geometry-only GLBs with named material library bindings
texture_binding.rule: runtime GLBs contain no images, textures, samplers or texture slots; each material stub carries extras.library_binding equal to its exact name and is replaced from this library (textures/<material>_<slot>.png, loaded as plain resources, never by the scene importer)
texture_binding.textured_sources: assets/generated/city_realism/textured_exports/<glb name>: full textured exports (../textures/<material>_<slot>.png URIs) with the same geometry, UV0, COLOR_0 and TANGENT bytes

channels.orm: R occlusion, G roughness, B metallic (glTF metallicRoughness uses G/B)

texture_binding.vertex_color: COLOR_0 multiplies albedo (AO x wear); TEXCOORD_0 is the only UV set
texture_binding.uv_density: tiles per metre in each material's uv_per_m (world-projected box UVs)

costs.texture_assumptions: RGBA8 + full mip chain per distinct PNG, no VRAM compression, shared by path (one copy regardless of how many GLBs use it)

limitations: box-projected world UVs (no unwrapped islands), so repeats show on very large faces
no interiors behind windows or bays beyond a dark hull
LOD1 is a massing proxy of walls, roof and trim only
COLOR_0 wear is per vertex on faces refined to 1.7-8 m cells, finer grime comes from textures
signs use a 16-tile 1024 atlas; text is mundane filler
